episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: What year were they doing the games in the Roman Colosseum?
So, I mean, what the fuck was it like being in there while that was happening?
And imagine when they'd flood it and they'd have the ships in there.
It's just, it's nuts that you could go walk around it and just try to understand, like, this used to be a place where people used to go to see people die.
They used to see people get hacked to death by swords, to see people get killed by lions.
Well, it's also interesting, too, because I did a lot of research, you know, before we filmed there.
And it also did a good job of, you know, back then they had, like, the hierarchy and, like, the nobles people would sit at the bottom and the poor people would be at the top.
And it also played a good role of showcasing unity, even though there are all these different people from all these different economic statuses.
They would all be in the arena there, but also remind them where they are.
And there's so many political implications of it, too.
And so just everything about it.
I didn't even think about that.
